summary: Expose read-only lookup through the CLI
description: Provide human and JSON output from the shared lookup service without a separate truth path.
acceptance: R-1: callersignal lookup accepts national input with --region and international E.164 input directly.
R-2: --json output validates against the shared lookup-result schema.

review_history.evidence: R-1 approved: four focused tests prove national --region input, direct international input, actionable missing-region failure, and agent-friendly human context. R-2 approved: CLI JSON equals the injected shared LookupService result and validates against lookup-result.schema.json with no divergent fields. All 88 repository tests and public-safety gates pass.
